purpose: Part 1/2 of verified hard-tail 13-record item effect batch 020; together these files contain exactly 13 reviewed records with complete captured mechanics.

items/dawnstar-633.name: Dawnstar [Relic]
items/dawnstar-633.effectSummary: For a lawful-good, neutral-good, chaotic-good, or neutral wielder, the weapon functions as a +2 morningstar. With the relic connection to Pelor, it gains brilliant energy; if the weapon is ever sundered or broken, it explodes for 200 damage within 10 feet, 150 within 20 feet, and 100 within 30 feet, Reflex DC 17 half, while leaving its wielder unharmed.

items/hooked-hammer-hearthfire-615.name: Hooked Hammer of the Hearthfire [Relic]
items/hooked-hammer-hearthfire-615.effectSummary: For a neutral-good, neutral, chaotic-good, or lawful-good wielder, the weapon functions as a +1/+1 gnome hooked hammer. With the relic connection to Garl Glittergold, both ends gain flaming and any kobold or goblinoid that grasps the handle takes 1d6 fire damage each round; with the stronger qualification, both ends gain flaming burst instead.

items/helm-of-darkness.name: Helm of Darkness
items/helm-of-darkness.effectSummary: The helm can create deeper darkness by command up to 99 times from its sapphire. Its 36 black opals each negate one failed save against a death effect or one incoming negative level, and each round it absorbs the first 30 cold damage. While at least one gem remains, the wearer is immune to fear, sees through darkness as daylight, can use speak with dead once per day, chill metal three times per day, and pass without trace at will; when all gems are spent, the helm loses its powers.

items/mooncloak.name: Mooncloak
items/mooncloak.effectSummary: The cloak functions as a cloak of resistance of its listed bonus and additionally lets the wearer use levitate and water walk, self only, once per day each.

items/rod-of-the-recluse-626.name: Rod of the Recluse [Relic]
items/rod-of-the-recluse-626.effectSummary: For a chaotic-evil, neutral-evil, or chaotic-neutral wielder, the rod functions as a +2 light mace. With the relic connection to Lolth, up to five times per day it can make the next melee attack deliver poison with Fortitude DC 20 and 2d6 Strength initial and secondary damage; on a critical hit, both instances become Strength drain.

items/shocking-burst-159.name: Shocking Burst
items/shocking-burst-159.effectSummary: A shocking burst weapon has the shock property and deals extra electricity damage on a successful critical hit: +1d10 for ×2, +2d10 for ×3, or +3d10 for ×4 critical multipliers. Ranged weapons pass the electricity to their ammunition, and the burst damage applies on critical hits even when the shock ability is inactive.

items/skewer-of-gnomes-624.name: Skewer-of-Gnomes [Relic]
items/skewer-of-gnomes-624.effectSummary: For a lawful-evil, lawful-neutral, or neutral-evil wielder, the Small spear functions as a +1 gnome-bane spear. With the relic connection to Kurtulmak, it also gains unholy and automatically sets itself against a charge, making an attack at the wielder's highest base attack bonus and relevant modifiers and dealing double damage whenever a foe charges the wielder.
